```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

# When testing can choose to only use a sample of rows to speed up iterations.
sample_rows = Inf
#sample_rows = 100000


dir_data = here::here("data/")
```

## Import file

```{r import_diagnoses}
# From 01-diagnoses.Rmd
system.time({
  df_diag = fst::read.fst(here::here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/diagnoses.fst")))
})

# Set as data.table
setDT(df_diag)

# Review
dim(df_diag)
class(df_diag)
names(df_diag)
```

## Filter conditions
Exposure window starts on May 7th, 2020
Outcome window starts immediately as exposure window ends on June 1st, 2020
Outcome window ends on July 31st, 2020
Pre expsoure we consider 6 months

ICD codes used: F41

We ensure icd code is present only in outcome window for the patient and not anytime before

```{r filter-parameters}
# Filter parameters

## Dates
pre_exposure <- as.Date("2020-05-07", format = "%Y-%m-%d") - months(6)
exposure_start <- as.Date("2020-05-07", format = "%Y-%m-%d")
outcome_start <- as.Date("2020-06-01", format = "%Y-%m-%d")
outcome_end <- as.Date("2020-07-31", format = "%Y-%m-%d")

## ICD codes
icd_codes <- sapply(c(0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 9), function(x) paste0("ICD10:F41.", x))


```


```{r filter-no-exposure-1mo}
# Filter

## get patients in outcome window
df_diag_outcome_patient <- unique(df_diag[sstart_date >= outcome_start & 
                              sstart_date <= outcome_end & icd10_code %in% icd_codes, empi])

## get patients in exposure window (1mo pre outcome window)
df_diag_pre_outcome_patient <- unique(df_diag[sstart_date >= exposure_start & 
                              sstart_date < outcome_start & icd10_code %in% icd_codes, empi])

## Identify patients diagnosed in outcome but not in pre outcome (1mo) window for the codes
patients_noexp_1mo <- setdiff(df_diag_outcome_patient, df_diag_pre_outcome_patient)
```


```{r filter-no-exposure-7mo}
# Filter

## get patients in outcome window
df_diag_outcome_patient <- unique(df_diag[sstart_date >= outcome_start & 
                              sstart_date <= outcome_end & icd10_code %in% icd_codes, empi])

## get patients in exposure and pre_exposure window (1+6 mo pre outcome window)
df_diag_pre_outcome_patient <- unique(df_diag[sstart_date >= pre_exposure & 
                              sstart_date < outcome_start & icd10_code %in% icd_codes, empi])

## Identify patients diagnosed in outcome but not in pre outcome window (1+6mo) for the codes
patients_noexp_7mo <- setdiff(df_diag_outcome_patient, df_diag_pre_outcome_patient)
```


```{r}
# Compare lengths
length(patients_noexp_1mo)
length(patients_noexp_7mo)
```


```{r}
# Get filtered data for both and review length

df_diag_noexp_1mo <- df_diag[empi %in% patients_noexp_1mo &
                               sstart_date >= exposure_start &
                               sstart_date <= outcome_end]

dim(df_diag_noexp_1mo)
```


```{r}
# Get filtered data for both and review length

df_diag_noexp_7mo <- df_diag[empi %in% patients_noexp_7mo &
                               sstart_date >= exposure_start &
                               sstart_date <= outcome_end]

dim(df_diag_noexp_7mo)
```


```{r}
# Clean
rm(df_diag)
gc()
```


## Import demographics

We join zip codes

```{r import_visits}
# From 03-demographics.Rmd
system.time({
  df_demo = fst::read.fst(here::here(paste0("data/rpdrml-", conf$rpdrml_version, "/demographics.fst")))
})

# Set as data.table
setDT(df_demo)

# Review
dim(df_demo)
class(df_demo)
names(df_demo)
```

```{r}
# Remove subject_num here

df_demo[, subject_num := NULL]
```

## Merge demographics to filtered diagnoses data
We need diagnoses for reference and especially to get zip codes

```{r}
# Merge

## For no exposure 1 month prior to outcome window
df_noexp_1mo <- merge(df_diag_noexp_1mo, df_demo, by = "empi", all.x = TRUE)

## For no exposure 7 month prior to outcome window
df_noexp_7mo <- merge(df_diag_noexp_7mo, df_demo, by = "empi", all.x = TRUE)
```



```{r}
# Clean
rm(df_demo, df_diag_noexp_1mo, df_diag_noexp_7mo)
gc()
```


## Add counts of total anxiety codes present

### For noexp 1mo
```{r}
# Get counts of anxiety code

## counts df
counts_df_anxiety <- df_noexp_1mo[icd10_code %in% icd_codes, .(anxiety_code_count = .N), by = .(empi)]
counts_df_noanxiety <- df_noexp_1mo[!icd10_code %in% c(icd_codes, ""), .(no_anxiety_code_count = .N), by = .(empi)]

## left join to original data table
df_noexp_1mo <- df_noexp_1mo[counts_df_anxiety, on = .(empi), anxiety_code_count := i.anxiety_code_count]
df_noexp_1mo <- df_noexp_1mo[counts_df_noanxiety, on = .(empi), no_anxiety_code_count := i.no_anxiety_code_count]

## Replace nulls with 0 for counts
df_noexp_1mo[is.na(anxiety_code_count), anxiety_code_count := 0]
df_noexp_1mo[is.na(no_anxiety_code_count), no_anxiety_code_count := 0]
```




### For noexp_7mo
```{r}
# Get counts of anxiety code

## counts df
counts_df_anxiety <- df_noexp_7mo[icd10_code %in% icd_codes, .(anxiety_code_count = .N), by = .(empi)]
counts_df_noanxiety <- df_noexp_7mo[!icd10_code %in% c(icd_codes, ""), .(no_anxiety_code_count = .N), by = .(empi)]

## left join to original data table
df_noexp_7mo <- df_noexp_7mo[counts_df_anxiety, on = .(empi), anxiety_code_count := i.anxiety_code_count]
df_noexp_7mo <- df_noexp_7mo[counts_df_noanxiety, on = .(empi), no_anxiety_code_count := i.no_anxiety_code_count]

## Replace nulls with 0 for counts
df_noexp_7mo[is.na(anxiety_code_count), anxiety_code_count := 0]
df_noexp_7mo[is.na(no_anxiety_code_count), no_anxiety_code_count := 0]
```


```{r}
# Clean
rm(counts_df_anxiety, counts_df_noanxiety)
gc()
```


## Add city and state using zip code

```{r load-file}
# Found on https://github.com/billfienberg/zip3/tree/master

system.time({
  df_zip3 = fread(here::here(paste0("data-raw/zip3.csv")), colClasses = c("character"))
})

setDT(df_zip3)
setnames(df_zip3, "id", "geo_zip3")
head(df_zip3)

```

```{r merge}
# Merge

## noexp 1mo
df_noexp_1mo <- merge(df_noexp_1mo, df_zip3, by = "geo_zip3", all.x = TRUE)

## noexp 7mo
df_noexp_7mo <- merge(df_noexp_7mo, df_zip3, by = "geo_zip3", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Clean

rm(df_zip3)
gc()
```
